title: Martin Romualdez's co-accused surrenders, granted conditional immunity
summary: A co-accused of Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez and former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co in the plunder charges they are facing before the Sandiganbayan surrendered on Friday to the National Bureau of…

blocks.text: A co-accused of Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez and former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co in the plunder charges they are facing before the Sandiganbayan surrendered on Friday to the National Bureau of Investigation.

According to the Office of the Ombudsman Felicito Guevarra, the president of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp., was granted conditional immunity "because his testimony and records are necessary to establish the truth in this case."

"Samchan has returned to the Bureau of the Treasury all its earnings from the questioned transactions. Restitution does not erase criminal liability. It is also not the basis of the immunity," the Ombudsman said in a statement.

"The Office granted Mr. Guevarra conditional immunity under Section 17 of Republic Act No. 6770 because his testimony and records are necessary to establish the truth in this case. The immunity rests on his full and truthful testimony," it added.
The Ombudsman said the conditions are as follows:

items: that Guevarra will cooperate fully and truthfully turn over all of Samchan's records and devices;
that he will remain in the country; and
that he will stay under DOJ protection.

blocks.text: "If he breaks any condition, his immunity will be revoked and his prosecution will resume," the Ombudsman said.
Guevarra personally handled Samchan's operations, said the Ombudsman.
"His testimony and records will help the prosecution trace the movement of funds alleged in the charge sheet. The charges against the other accused stand as filed," the Ombudsman said.
"All accused are presumed innocent. The evidence will be presented in court," it added. —NB, GMA News
